name: Tōmi (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Tōmi city emblem in navy, light blue and orange: navy and light blue stylised swooshes with an orange disc.
history: Municipal flag of Tōmi, a city in Nagano Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 1 April 2004.
